text:
Aisha: Morning async — quick check-in on gateway stuff. What I did: landed small fix to route-match ordering (PR #432). Blockers: still seeing 429 spikes on /v1/generate during bursts. Today: want to pair on rate-limiter tuning + update handoff docs.

Ben: Where are the spikes coming from? Customer traffic or internal tests?

Aisha: Mostly from PL service + our internal test harness. Spikes cluster around 11:45 UTC. Logs show `429 from ratelimiter token_bucket overflow` repeatedly.

Chris: Can you paste the token bucket config you have for that route? We moved token_refill last week and might've under-provisioned burst.

Aisha: Config snippet: `rate_limit: 100r/s; burst: 200; token_refill: 5/s`

Dana: Suggestion: increase burst for the /v1/generate route to 400 and add a per-customer fallback. Also enable prefix KV caching to reduce repeated token consumption for identical prompts.

Ben: Filed a quick staging change — PR 445 updates the route-level burst to 400 and adds a canary (10% traffic) for the change.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started deployment for staging/config-update (PR 445) by Ben.

Aisha: Thanks — I'll monitor 429 counts and latency after the canary. If still noisy, we should enable a short request queueing window (100ms) before returning 429s.

Chris: @Aisha can you share the Kusto/PromQL you use to watch 429s so I can add it to the dashboard?

Aisha: Use this PromQL: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{status_code="429",route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))` — also check `ratelimiter_overflows_total` and `ratelimiter_queue_depth`.

Dana: :thumbsup: I'll add a note to the runbook about increasing burst and assign ownership to @Dana for the short-term change. Also adding a reminder to coordinate with Security before touching auth configs.

Ben: No blockers from my side. Today I'll finish the canary rollout and follow up with a fallback policy CR (per-customer soft-limits).

Aisha: Small heads-up: seeing some auth jitter — JWT verification latency spikes for a subset of tokens, causing slowdowns upstream. We may need to roll JWT verifier to 0.9.2.

Chris: Okay — I'll queue the verifier roll tomorrow and add `request_id` to ratelimiter logs to make troubleshooting easier.

Aisha: Great, thanks everyone. I'll post a quick update after the canary stabilizes.

Ben: Thanks — ping if you want pairing time.

Chris: will follow up on the logging change.

Dana: I'll update the runbook and schedule a short sync if the canary shows anomalies.

Aisha: End of thread.
